items.headline: Kimi Antonelli is F1 world champion — the youngest ever
items.body: Antonelli sealed his first title in Mexico City by finishing third as Max Verstappen won a chaotic race. At 20 years and 68 days old, he's the youngest champion in Formula 1 history.
items.say: Did you catch it? Kimi Antonelli just became the youngest Formula 1 champ ever — the kid's only 20.

items.headline: Burrow throws for 462 as the Bengals outlast the Titans in OT
items.body: Joe Burrow went full gunslinger — 462 passing yards in a 43-36 overtime shootout in Cincinnati. Over in Buffalo, the Bills hammered Baltimore 36-10.
items.say: 462 passing yards and overtime — did you see Burrow drag the Bengals past the Titans?

items.headline: Luka drops 45 as the Lakers hold off the Raptors
items.body: Dončić was unstoppable — 45 points, 15 rebounds, 8 threes and 5 steals in a 131-125 win. It's his fourth straight game with 37-plus.
items.say: Luka's on a heater — 45 and eight threes, four games in a row over 37. Think the Lakers are for real?

items.headline: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time in 16 years
items.body: Kai Havertz's early header gave Arsenal a 1-0 win at Liverpool — their first league victory at Anfield since 2012, and a statement at the top of the table.
items.say: Arsenal finally won at Anfield — first time in 16 years. Big one if you follow the Premier League.

items.headline: Tom Nolan stops Moicano in a wild Vegas main event
items.body: Aussie lightweight Tom Nolan finished Renato Moicano with third-round elbows after a controversial referee stand-up — his sixth straight UFC win.
items.say: The Tom Nolan–Moicano finish had everyone arguing about that ref call. You see it?

items.headline: Worlds knockouts start this week — T1 chasing a four-peat
items.body: The League of Legends World Championship Swiss stage wrapped with eight teams into the single-elimination bracket. Three-time defending champ T1 is hunting a fourth straight title on the road to the final in Brooklyn.
items.say: League of Legends Worlds hits the knockout rounds this week — T1's going for four titles in a row.

items.headline: The 'Avengers: Doomsday' countdown is on — out December 18
items.body: Marvel's mega-crossover with Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom is just weeks away. If you haven't rewatched the trailer, it's a doozy.
items.say: Avengers: Doomsday is only about six weeks out — are you cautiously excited or is Marvel back?

items.headline: 20 years later, My Chemical Romance finally hit No. 1
items.body: The 20th-anniversary reissue rocketed 'The Black Parade' to the top of the Billboard 200 — MCR's first-ever No. 1 album, two decades after it came out.
items.say: Wild one for music nerds — My Chemical Romance got their first-ever No. 1 album, 20 years after 'The Black Parade.'

items.headline: Keira Knightley's 'Black Doves' is back Thursday
items.body: Netflix's hit spy thriller returns for season 2 on November 5 — Helen's still quietly leaking secrets while her husband eyes 10 Downing Street.
items.say: The 'Black Doves' spy thriller drops season 2 Thursday — did you get through the first one?
